name: Dr. Eleanor Vance
bio: Dr. Vance has over 15 years of experience focusing on complex internal health issues in dogs and cats. She's passionate about diagnostic challenges.

name: Dr. Marcus Chen
bio: A gifted surgeon, Dr. Chen specializes in advanced orthopedic and soft tissue procedures, ensuring optimal outcomes for his patients.

name: Dr. Sofia Rodriguez
bio: Dr. Rodriguez is dedicated to providing immediate, life-saving care in critical situations, with a calm and compassionate approach.

name: Dr. David Kim
bio: Dr. Kim has a unique expertise in the care of birds, reptiles, and small mammals, ensuring even the most unusual pets get top-notch treatment.
